text: Ernest J. Gaines's A Lesson Before Dying was banned in Savannah (GA) in 2001 after protests about its sexual content, violence, and profanity, and was later reinstated. In July 2008, two parents challenged the book in the Huntsville City Schools in Huntsville, Alabama, objecting to sexual references and profanity and asking that it be removed from the ninth grade required summer reading lists.
